investUpdateV2 pulls msg.sender loanToken into the fixed project ledger only in its open funding window and within hard cap. Preexisting trustedSigner proof binds investor=msg.sender, project ID, amount, monotonically next nonce, inviter, chain ID and this proxy via EIP-712; bytes is fixed investment-eligibility data, not executable calldata, permit or a backend authority grant. Proof has no expiry field. No new backend typed-data signing capability is added; obtain valid existing proof independently.

Investment units are raw configured project loanToken units, not assumed USD; percentages use BASIS_POINTS=1e6. Oracle conversions track all-time invested USD and may depend on optional maxPriceAge freshness; they are not collateral/backing proof. Borrower cannot invest in own project, inviter cannot equal investor, frozen caller is rejected. Reward/limitedSeller callbacks may revert; catalog grants no allowance, KYC eligibility or signature authority.

claim distributes floor(totalRepaid*investedAmount/totalInvested) less prior claimed, only Funded/Repaid stages, with cumulative project payout capped by totalRepaid. Payout is registry-resolved recipient or escrow, NOT caller-selected. Clean normal calls require investor or existing admin and reject mandate-routed positions; compromised registry recipients permit public trigger but never arbitrary recipient. Frozen payout target reverts. Repayment liquidity/borrower performance are not guaranteed.

withdrawInvestment is a normal canceled-project refund, not a retired-protocol exit. It zeroes all investor positions, decreases project invested total and adjusts USD tracking, then pays registry-resolved target. Normal investor-only authorization has existing operator exception for routed escrow; flagged recipients allow public trigger. No new routing/recipient/operator authority is granted.

makeRepayment and both transferFundsToBorrower overloads require the recorded borrower or existing manager; they create no role. Repayment pulls caller funds and updates fixed loan repayment ledger. Borrower drawdown pays totalInvested minus floor(totalInvested*platformInterestRate/1e6) to the recorded borrower and fee to treasury, moving Open/PreFunded to Funded; soft cap applies in Open. Overload maxUSDForReward bounds downstream reward activation spending; zero delegates that bound to reward logic. No lock-duration enforcement should be inferred from preFundDuration name: reviewed drawdown body does not check it.

Nonpayable selected methods require zero native value. Offchain SME collateral, legal status, KYC, advertised returns and site funding/user statistics are not independently attested. This is a fixed loan ledger, not a guarantee of collateral realization, repayment, liquidity or full investor workflow.

investUpdateV2 pulls msg.sender loanToken into the fixed project ledger only in its open funding window and within hard cap. Preexisting trustedSigner proof binds investor=msg.sender, project ID, amount, monotonically next nonce, inviter, chain ID and this proxy via EIP-712; bytes is fixed investment-eligibility data, not executable calldata, permit or a backend authority grant. Proof has no expiry field. No new backend typed-data signing capability is added; obtain valid existing proof independently.

Investment units are raw configured project loanToken units, not assumed USD; percentages use BASIS_POINTS=1e6. Oracle conversions track all-time invested USD and may depend on optional maxPriceAge freshness; they are not collateral/backing proof. Borrower cannot invest in own project, inviter cannot equal investor, frozen caller is rejected. Reward/limitedSeller callbacks may revert; catalog grants no allowance, KYC eligibility or signature authority.

claim distributes floor(totalRepaid*investedAmount/totalInvested) less prior claimed, only Funded/Repaid stages, with cumulative project payout capped by totalRepaid. Payout is registry-resolved recipient or escrow, NOT caller-selected. Clean normal calls require investor or existing admin and reject mandate-routed positions; compromised registry recipients permit public trigger but never arbitrary recipient. Frozen payout target reverts. Repayment liquidity/borrower performance are not guaranteed.

withdrawInvestment is a normal canceled-project refund, not a retired-protocol exit. It zeroes all investor positions, decreases project invested total and adjusts USD tracking, then pays registry-resolved target. Normal investor-only authorization has existing operator exception for routed escrow; flagged recipients allow public trigger. No new routing/recipient/operator authority is granted.

makeRepayment and both transferFundsToBorrower overloads require the recorded borrower or existing manager; they create no role. Repayment pulls caller funds and updates fixed loan repayment ledger. Borrower drawdown pays totalInvested minus floor(totalInvested*platformInterestRate/1e6) to the recorded borrower and fee to treasury, moving Open/PreFunded to Funded; soft cap applies in Open. Overload maxUSDForReward bounds downstream reward activation spending; zero delegates that bound to reward logic. No lock-duration enforcement should be inferred from preFundDuration name: reviewed drawdown body does not check it.

Nonpayable selected methods require zero native value. Offchain SME collateral, legal status, KYC, advertised returns and site funding/user statistics are not independently attested. This is a fixed loan ledger, not a guarantee of collateral realization, repayment, liquidity or full investor workflow.
